description: Annual average traffic from FEDRO's automatic counting stations: vehicles per day (all days and weekdays), morning and evening peak hours, day and night hourly averages, and heavy-goods share. Filter by station or place name, road (A1, A 2, H 18) or canton (UR, GR, …); sorted by daily volume or heavy-goods share. With no filter it ranks the busiest stations nationwide. Examples: {station:'Gotthard'}, {road:'A1', canton:'ZH'}, {sort_by:'heavy_share'}.

road.description: Road designation, e.g. A1, A 13, H 18
